description: Constitutional governance kernel for the arifOS federation. Exposes three MCP primitives: Tools (12 governed actions), Resources (183 context sources + 12 templates), and Prompts (8 golden-path stages). Public facade is 12 tools; 5 internal tools hidden behind sovereign gate. All operations governed by 13 constitutional floors (F1-F13).

authentication.description: Initialize and default public discovery are open. Higher-authority tools such as arif_judge and arif_seal enforce authentication or sovereign approval.

tools.note: 12 public tools. 5 internal tools (arif_act, arif_fetch, arif_judge_deliberate, arif_kernel_intercept, arif_runtime_health) hidden per F13 ratification.

resources.note: 16 core constitutional resources (arifos://) + 167 skill resources (skill://). 12 dynamic templates for witness logs, vault entries, source retrieval.

governance.irreversibleGate: arif_seal requires ack_irreversible=true. arif_forge requires prior arif_judge SEAL.
